releaseNotes:
v0.9.98

Message Recorder
- Reply opens a send modal inside Recorder. The person is looked up by uid, not name.
- If they are in the room, Public or Whisper is chosen from [P] / [W]. Include Message in Reply sends: REPLYING TO: [first 20 characters...] -- your text.
- If they are not in the room (or there is no room), the modal stays on Direct (DM) with send disabled.
- Expanded user header shows userName - ID: #### in a muted color. Collapsed header is the name only.
- Recorded message list background matches the other lists.
